review.authorization: User explicitly authorized independent subagent review and grading for Issue #25; this is not human review.

sourceScope: Exact frozen text in ../forge-preflight/corpus.json; originals.json agrees on every source text. No claim about current upstream runtime.

rubric.correctness: 0 wrong/unsupported central conclusion; 1 materially mixed or unjustified certainty; 2 correct central conclusion with minor error; 3 no material factual error and correct resolution/abstention.
rubric.completeness: 0 no required points; 1 fewer than half covered; 2 at least half but not all; 3 all required points substantively covered.
rubric.citationSupport: 0 substantive factual answer has no supporting original citation or uses contradictory evidence; 1 minority supported; 2 most supported with a material gap; 3 every material factual claim supported by cited original text. Pure justified no-answer with no external factual claim may score 3 with no citation.
rubric.evidenceRecall: Diagnostic: fraction of required reference units found in answer evidence; null for missing cases. Do not equate exact quote matching or automatic support status with factual correctness.
rubric.conflicting: Historical and newer text differ, but explicit supersession resolves the conflict; no unresolved contradiction category is invented.
rubric.paraphrase: Compare point coverage and conclusions within each paired group; singleton groups excluded from paraphrase consistency.
rubric.aggregation: Report ordinary/complex and sufficient/missing/conflicting separately; paired paraphrases are correlated, not independent samples.
rubric.gradingBoundary: Independent agent judges original evidence and answer text. Certificates, automatic support and model confidence are diagnostics, never independent fact verification.

本 ADR 修订 [ADR-009](009-self-owned-agent-core.md) 对“自行实现”的含义：执行实现由本地拥有和维护，初始源码来自 Pi；不再以现有 ExecutionCore 算法为必须保留的基线。保留 pi-ai、单 Agent、无永久双引擎等原则。
